proposals.evidence: Andersen's i- 'to go' head explicitly compares RV eti and Pali eti. Turner 2515 ḗti 'goes' identifies √i, cites Pali ēti and exact Ashokan eti. The source head is the verbal root-stem label for this inherited family.

proposals.evidence: Andersen's vas- 'live, stay' head explicitly compares RV vasati and Pali vasati and cross-references vāsin-/vivas-. Turner 11435 vásati 'stays, dwells' identifies √vas, cites Pali vasati and exact Ashokan vasati. This is the same inherited verbal family.
